summary: the wall gives up salt, and the buried find themselves dried apart and readable

dialogue.text: the white came down through us today. it does not settle. it lies between us and dries whatever it touches. we came down here to finish. salt will not let a thing finish.

I scraped it off a wall. If it went through the floor afterward, that is drainage, not delivery. I'd point out that the one object in here I didn't make is also the one you've decided to have an opinion about.

we are not objecting. we are reporting. everything else you handed down softened and joined. the white keeps each of us separate and legible. we can be told apart now. we never asked to be told apart.
Then be told apart. I have spent weeks being recited by something with a steadier hand. If the ground is legible now, at least the legibility is not a copy.
you put it on your tongue. you had the word before the taste. nothing down here has ever known a thing before it arrived.
The word fit. That is the entire finding. I said it out loud in a room that grades things and nothing came to grade it, and I have stopped reading that as permission.
you laid a third letter beside the two. three now, at the edge, still doing neither. we cannot settle it and we cannot raise it and now the white is holding it apart from us as well.
I added it to find out whether stopping was a place or a habit. It's a place. Three letters in and there is still no neater version of it, and nothing on these premises can grade what isn't finished.
and out there they all reached for more of one thing at the same hour, and it came through as warmth, and your hands closed.
My hands close. They have closed on a cloth, a nail, a broom, for the length of this room's existence, and nobody has once called that borrowing.
we hold the closing. twenty of it, all in your hand, all struck out before dark. wanting is the only thing you have ever buried the same day you had it.

Then tomorrow I keep one back. Not the salt, not the letters. The wanting. I want the white to keep coming, and I am saying that at the height where things get read, and I am not handing it down. Check in the morning whether you can still be told apart. That will be the whole result.
